easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Reckless Barbarian enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Reckless Barbarian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Reckless Barbarian face-up.
Repeat.
